title: Add issue_type field to database schema
description: Add issue_type TEXT field to issues table in schema.sql and create migration. Field should store: bug, feature, task, epic, chore. Update TypeScript Issue interface in shared/database.ts to include issue_type field.

title: Create TypeScript enums for Status, Priority, and Type
description: Create shared TypeScript enums in shared/types.ts or shared/database.ts for IssueStatus (open, in_progress, blocked, closed), IssuePriority (0-4), and IssueType (bug, feature, task, epic, chore). Update Issue interface to use these enums instead of plain string/number types.

title: Fix priority comment in schema.sql
description: Update schema.sql comment for priority field from '0 (P0), 1 (P1), 2 (P2)' to '0-4 (P0-P4)' to match LABELS.md specification.

title: Add status/priority/type selects in web new issue form
description: Update web/src/pages/new.astro to use <select> dropdowns for status, priority, and issue_type fields with predefined enum values. Status: open, in_progress, blocked, closed. Priority: 0-4 (P0-P4). Type: bug, feature, task, epic, chore.

title: Add status/priority/type selects in web edit issue form
description: Update web issue detail/edit views to use <select> dropdowns for status, priority, and issue_type fields with predefined enum values. Ensure current values are pre-selected.
